title: Refactor Skill Activity Execution into Template Method with Colocated Configuration

story.so_that: the generic Skill Activity runner can support new Activities without skill-name conditionals, each Activity owns its configuration alongside its code, and Devin-specific CLI details stay inside DevinHarness
story.as_a: Software Engineer maintaining the skill orchestration layer and adding new workflow Activities
story.i_want: to refactor `run_skill` into a `SkillActivity` template-method class with adjacent per-Activity JSON configuration and an immutable, namespaced Harness configuration mapping

journey.before: Morgan maintains the orchestration layer, adds new Skills, reviews ADRs, manages the central skill catalog, and troubleshoots Activity lifecycle issues.
journey.during: Morgan refactors the generic `run_skill` function into a `SkillActivity` template method, creates adjacent `*.config.json` files, updates the `Harness.run` signature, and validates that concrete Activities can be added without touching generic code.
journey.after: Morgan verifies the template order, sentinel handling, logging, and output resolution remain compatible, and that new Activities can be added by creating a class and a config file.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Refactor the generic Skill Activity runner into a template-method class and move per-Activity configuration into adjacent JSON files.
inputs: Proposed template-method and namespaced configuration design
outputs: Base `SkillActivity` class with fixed `execute` method and typed no-op hooks
Adjacent `*.config.json` files for each concrete Activity
Refactored Activity wrappers using the new template
Passing tests for template order, configuration loading, namespaced Harness translation, and compatibility
state_changes: Central skill-name branches in `_conventional_output_path` are removed
Activity behavior and configuration are colocated

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each concrete Skill Activity has an adjacent JSON configuration.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a concrete Skill Activity exists When its configuration is loaded Then an adjacent JSON file provides its activity and harness settings
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Configure each Activity from a colocated file

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Adding a new Activity requires no edit to a central skill-name switch or Devin profile map.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a new Skill Activity is added When it is registered with the worker Then no central skill-name switch or Devin profile map needs to be modified
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Add a Skill Activity without touching generic code

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Harness.run receives an immutable namespaced configuration mapping.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a Skill Activity is configured with harness settings When it invokes the Harness Then the Harness receives an immutable mapping containing its own namespace

acceptance_criteria.criterion: DevinHarness alone validates devin settings and translates them to CLI arguments.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a configuration contains a devin namespace When DevinHarness runs Then it validates the devin settings and translates them to CLI arguments
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Let DevinHarness own Devin CLI translation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unknown keys inside devin fail; unrelated Harness namespaces are ignored.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a devin namespace contains an unknown key or a sibling harness namespace exists When the configuration is validated Then unknown devin keys are rejected and sibling namespaces are ignored
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Keep harness namespaces isolated and strict

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SkillActivity.execute owns and preserves the complete lifecycle order.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a SkillActivity is invoked When execute runs Then it performs the documented lifecycle steps in order and does not skip or reorder them
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Rely on a stable Activity lifecycle

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Prompt, sentinel path, Harness config, invocation context, output path, and result have typed no-op transformation hooks.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a concrete SkillActivity overrides a typed hook When execute runs Then the hook receives and returns the same type and can replace its value
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Specialize Activity behavior through typed hooks

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Required identity and output contract fields fail at construction/startup rather than after invocation.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a concrete SkillActivity is missing a required identity or output field When it is constructed or the Worker starts Then it fails before any invocation

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing Activity wire names, argument shapes, output shape, sentinel validation, logging hygiene, and retry behavior remain compatible.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the refactor is complete When existing Activities are invoked Then wire names, shapes, output, sentinel validation, logging, and retry behavior remain compatible

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All unit and live integration checks pass before removing the old interface.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the refactor is implemented When the test suite and live integration checks run Then they pass before the old run_skill interface is removed
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Verify the refactor before removing the old interface
